steps.why: Art. 270b OR requires the tenant to contest a rent increase before the conciliation authority within 30 days after receiving it. The existing workflow preserves the deadline but does not expressly ensure that the challenge is filed with the competent authority; a message saying “I am contesting” does not establish that this procedural filing has occurred.

result.summary: Ana Morais contests a rent increase for her flat. The message gives a monthly rent increase from CHF 2,050 to CHF 2,290 effective 1 April (year unstated), and says the landlord relies on a higher mortgage reference interest rate and stairwell renovation/new lift. She accepts that the reference rate rose, but questions the lift’s value and possible double counting. The evaluated checklist lists as missing: lease contract, rent increase notice, proof of receipt, current rent evidence, prior rent adjustment, stated reasons and calculation, reference-rate basis, renovation cost breakdown, landlord correspondence (optional), proof of challenge filing with the conciliation authority (suggested), and itemized allocation of renovation costs between maintenance and value-adding works (suggested).
result.answer: The available message is not enough to assess prospects or establish the objection deadline; obtain the notice and proof/date of receipt urgently, together with the listed calculation evidence.
open_points: The objection deadline cannot be determined: the file does not state when the notice was received, and the rent increase notice and proof of receipt are listed as missing.
The notice’s form, addressee, calculation inputs and stated basis need review; the rent increase notice and stated reasons/calculation are listed as missing.
The amount and basis of the reference-rate component remain open; the reference-rate basis is listed as missing.

The eligible share of renovation costs, including whether lift costs relate to maintenance or value-adding work and whether costs were counted twice, remains open; the renovation cost breakdown is listed as missing and the itemized maintenance/value-adding allocation is a suggested missing item.
Current rent components and the previous adjustment basis remain unknown; current rent evidence and prior rent adjustment are listed as missing.
Whether a challenge was filed with the conciliation authority and when is unknown; proof of challenge filing is listed as a suggested missing item.
The lease contract is listed as missing. Landlord correspondence is also listed as missing (optional).

clauses.text: You say the increase is from CHF 2,050 to CHF 2,290 per month, effective 1 April, and that the stated reasons are the higher mortgage reference interest rate and the stairwell renovation/new lift.
You say you accept that the reference rate went up, but question whether the lift adds value and whether costs have been counted twice.

On the information available, I cannot determine the objection deadline or assess your prospects: the rent increase notice and proof of receipt are not available, and the receipt date is not established.

Please send the rent increase notice and any envelope, delivery record or other proof showing when you received it, and tell us whether and when you filed a challenge with the conciliation authority; if you filed, please send the filing confirmation.
Please also send your lease contract, evidence of the current rent and its components, the previous rent adjustment, and the landlord’s stated reasons and calculation.

Please provide the reference-rate basis and the renovation cost breakdown; an itemized allocation between maintenance and value-adding work could help clarify the lift issue and the question of possible double counting.

events.summary: Rentenerhöhungsstreit. Die Nachricht nennt als Gründe den höheren Referenzzinssatz sowie Treppenhausrenovation und neuen Lift; Monatsmiete CHF 2'050 auf CHF 2'290 ab 1. April. Ana hinterfragt den Mehrwert des Lifts (alter Lift fiel oft aus) und mögliche Doppelzählung. Mietzinserhöhungsanzeige, Empfangsdatum, Berechnung, Mietvertrag und Belege fehlen; Jahr unbekannt, daher ist die 30-Tage-Frist nicht bestimmbar. Keine Knowledge-Items angewandt. Ergänzungen vorgeschlagen: Schritt zur Prüfung einer Anfechtung bei der Schlichtungsbehörde samt Fristwahrung und Beleg; Beleg der Einreichung (Art. 270b OR); Aufschlüsselung von Unterhalt/Reparatur gegenüber wertvermehrenden Arbeiten (Art. 269a lit. b OR).
